exposure: Maternal autoimmune disease (systemic lupus erythematosus, primary Sjögren's syndrome)
cohort: 212 anti-Ro/SSA-positive pregnancies prospectively followed at a single center in Stockholm County, Sweden, between 2000 and 2013, compared with 352,104 pregnancies in the Stockholm County Medical Birth Registry
finding: Maternal systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) was associated with higher rates of cesarean section, preterm birth, and growth retardation, while fetal congenital heart block was not associated with maternal SLE diagnosis but was rare in the overall population.
